findings.message: Attribution precision (sources): docs/semester-1/gict-300/unit-06/topic-03.mdx:51-57 attributes a three-part framing rule to (UNESCO, 2021). The bound excerpt specs/content/gict-300/sources/texts/unescoAI2021.md:13-23 directly corroborates enhance-not-replace and human accountability, but its stated corroborated themes (human-centred AI; ethics, gender equality and equity) do not spell out the "protect learners' data and agency" clause. The clause is a fair unpacking of human-centred/ethics and is consistent with the actual 2021 guidance, but it is one step beyond the excerpt's stated corroboration; tighten the excerpt record or the prose in a future cycle.

Self-description inaccuracy (sources): specs/content/gict-300/sources/unit-06.md:3-5 states every key is "cited both in prose and in a per-topic ## Further reading section", but khanacademyCIT, ncaStaysafe, ncsp2021 and stairReynolds appear only in Further reading lists (topic-01.mdx:141-149, topic-02.mdx:122-130, topic-04.mdx:145-154), never in-text. The posture itself is conservative and correct for unbound sources; only the blanket sentence overstates.

Loose corroboration cross-references (sources): the ## Unverifiable sources declarations (sources/unit-06.md:42-50) assert the web-journey/communication/safe-browsing content is "carried by" the bound bourgeois2019 chapter 5/6 excerpts, but those excerpts (sources/texts/bourgeois2019.md:80-119) carry the network/phishing/password layer, not the U6-03 communication-tool taxonomy or the U6-04 padlock-encryption and domain-anatomy specifics. The prose claims themselves are elementary, accurate ICT-literacy content, so no factual defect results; the declarations' "carried by" wording overstates excerpt coverage for those sub-topics.

Interpretive gloss on alAnsi2023 (sources): topic-04.mdx:69-78 characterises the review as finding "evidence of learning gain beyond engagement is still maturing"; the bound abstract (sources/texts/alAnsi2023.md:11-24) supports engagement/immersion/simulation gains, developing-stage status and massive investment, but states no explicit finding about learning-gain evidence. The gloss is hedged, consistent with the review's framing, and RRQ-10's model answer presents it as an implication; recorded for attribution precision.

Integrative ERQ object (assessment): the spec ERQ blueprint line asks for "one integrative item assessing an emerging technology's fit for a Pakistani school" (content-spec.md ## Unit 6). The bank's integrative item, ERQ-5 (unit-assessment.mdx:139-141), evaluates the teacher's questioning stance across at least three course units, while the fit-for-a-Pakistani-school assessment is carried by ERQ-4 (:137-138) and ERQ-3. The outcome is covered by the bank as a whole; the split is a wording-level deviation from the blueprint line, not a coverage gap.

Concept-graph linkage (assessment): MCQ-10 (UNESCO framing rule, unit-assessment.mdx:100-105) appears in no concept row in specs/content/gict-300/concepts/unit-06.md. The concept-graph contract requires only that listed item IDs exist, so this is contract-compliant (check:concept-graph exit 0), and the rule is taught in topic-03.mdx:51-57 and retrieval-tested in topic-03's check-your-understanding item 4; recorded in case the graph is later expected to be item-total.

Bare-URL link text (accessibility): render-inspect flagged the Further reading sections' bare URLs as link text (3/3/3/2 links across topic-01..04.mdx). Screen readers announce the raw URL. This is conventional for bibliographic citations where the URL is itself the information; a future cycle could pair readable link text with a visible URL.

Environment transparency (out of scope): this worktree's base carries pre-existing red gates wholly attributable to geng-300 (stale docs/semester-1/geng-300 tree; 9 em dashes in specs/content/geng-300/intake/evaluation.md), already fixed on the unmerged sibling branch 018-author-geng300. All six deterministic gates were run twice: as-is (baseline logs-20260923T171945671Z-baseline, every failure geng-300-attributed, zero GICT-300 findings) and with the sibling branch's committed geng-300 fixes applied to the unbound geng-300 paths only (logs-20260923T171945671Z, all six exit 0) - the same approach as this unit's G2 evidence. No bound input of this review was modified; the worktree was restored and verified clean of tracked changes with the input manifest re-verified at 101/101 digests.

Render host identity (accessibility): render-inspect used the default port 4599, which a concurrent session's overlay server (/tmp/gict300-g3-overlay) may also have held during the run. Post-hoc verification diffed that overlay's build against this worktree's build for the unit-06 route: HTML content and all figure assets are identical (differences are global asset-bundle hashes and CSS-module class suffixes only), so the recorded renders and print PDFs bind to the current committed unit-06 bytes regardless of which server answered. A host capacity directive received after the run requested no further build or browser work; none was started afterwards.
